title: Counter-loop configuration layout
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $x$ be an input word, let $q$ be an optional counter-loop state, and let $c$ be a configuration with $k$ work tapes on input $x$. Given counter-tape contents $ct$ indexed by integers and a counter-head position $cp$, the counter-loop configuration has state $q$, the same input-head position and output as $c$, and work tapes and head positions obtained by appending $ct$ and $cp$ as the final tape and head position.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration with $k$ work tapes on input $x$
$ct$ assigns optional symbols to integer positions
